verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman who ever dug an iron hill with her breasts; and an infant cried from that side of the hill, and the cry ever continued; but the infant comes not to the mother, nor the mother to the infant.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, became pregnant, not from her own husband, but from another person; and she said thus: "I have bot been pregnant." She also destroyed the infant.'
